Our Story

Built on Vision,
Driven by Precision

Space Utilizers was founded in 2024 to fill a gap in the design market — a studio that combines architectural rigour with deeply personal, boutique-scale service.

Est.
2024

Why We Started

A Studio Born From
Conviction

After years of working within large, impersonal architecture firms, our founders saw a recurring pattern: clients felt disconnected from their own design process. Decisions were made in boardrooms, not living rooms. Creativity was diluted by bureaucracy.

Space Utilizers was created to change that. We believe every client deserves founder-level attention — where the person who envisions your space is also the one who brings it to life. No account managers. No handoffs. Just direct, expert collaboration from concept to completion.

Our name says it all: we don't just decorate spaces — we utilize them. Every corner has purpose. Every material has meaning. Every design decision is intentional.

The People

Our Founding Team

Three distinct disciplines. Decades of collective experience. One unified vision for how spaces should make people feel.

Arjun Mehta

Co-Founder & Lead Architect

With 15 years spanning high-rise residential complexes and heritage restorations, Arjun brings structural intuition and a deep respect for context. He studied at IIT Delhi and has led projects across three countries.

Priya Sharma

Co-Founder & Design Director

A spatial psychology specialist, Priya approaches interiors as environments that shape behaviour. Her portfolio includes luxury residences, boutique hotels, and award-winning retail concepts.

Rohan Kapoor

Head of Projects

Rohan is the bridge between vision and reality. With 12 years in construction management and contractor coordination, he ensures that every design detail is executed with uncompromising precision.

Our Philosophy

Mathematical Precision
Meets Artistic Flair

We approach every project at the intersection of science and art — where ergonomic data informs creative expression, and every aesthetic choice serves a functional purpose.

What Guides Us

Our Core Values

◇

Intentional Design

Every element earns its place. We reject decoration for decoration's sake — each material, colour, and form serves a clear spatial purpose.

◎

Client Intimacy

We deliberately limit our client roster to ensure founder-level attention on every project. You'll never be an account number here.

△

Transparent Process

No hidden costs, no surprise changes. Our process is documented, shared, and open at every stage — from concept to handover.

⬡

Sustainable Thinking

We prioritise materials and methods that respect the environment. Good design should serve future generations, not burden them.
